Package com.microservices.warehouse.storages.services

Class StorageServiceManagement

java.lang.Object
com.microservices.warehouse.storages.services.StorageServiceManagement
@Service public class StorageServiceManagement extends Object
Service class for managing storage operations. This class interacts with various services and performs operations related to storage management, such as inserting, updating, and removing storages. It also handles functionalities related to addresses, reservations, bookmarks, and favorites.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Pouria Ghafarbeigi
